customers_say: Customers find the door lock to be a great product with premium build quality and a clean appearance. The functionality receives positive feedback, with one customer noting it works even in complete darkness. The value for money receives mixed reviews.

reviews.author: Lohith N
reviews.title: Free from keys!
reviews.body: Delivery was prompt. Installation took time and was dusty but was done neatly. Have been using it from >15 days and I would say it's made my life easy one (key less) at a time! Pros: No need to carry keys, no need to ask someone at home to lock the door when going out as it automatically locks. Camera unlocks even if it's dark. Battery is at 70% even after >15 days. Good job UC. Product price is at a higher end but worth. Cons: Mine was a heavy Honne wood door and sometimes the door gets stuck (mostly due to weather changes) instead of opening but it's the door and not the lock.

reviews.author: pratik raj
reviews.title: Superb product and built quality
reviews.body: nice lock with great 2 way talk, camera and lurker alarm. I am happy with the product. Customer care of urban company sucks. That is only negative thing that i saw

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Excellent Product, Delayed Installation
reviews.body: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ The lock looks premium, has great features, and the installation by Prakaash was excellent. He was professional, helpful, and explained everything clearly. The only thing was the installation process. I had to raise a support ticket and follow up manually, and the installation was completed about a week later. Apart from that, everything went smoothly. Overall, a great product with a good first impression.
